scope: A first cut of Brazil's institutional capability infrastructure: constitutional anchors, oversight bodies, and organizations that concentrate finance, data, learning, science, technology and delivery capacity. Sao Paulo is the first subnational pilot.

nodes.summary: Heads the federal executive, coordinates the government and converts political priorities into administrative decisions.

source.title: Constituição da República Federativa do Brasil

nodes.summary: Represents the population in the lower house, passes laws and the budget, and scrutinizes the executive.
Represents the states in Congress, passes laws and confirms appointments specified by the Constitution.
Guards the Constitution and decides whether laws and government acts stay within it.
Standardizes the interpretation of federal law outside direct constitutional questions.

source.title: Atribuições do Superior Tribunal de Justiça

nodes.summary: Exercises external control over federal accounts and resources on behalf of Congress.
Heads the Federal Public Prosecution Service and acts in public-interest cases before the higher courts.
Represents the Union in court and provides legal guidance to the federal administration.
Audits the federal executive and coordinates integrity, ombudsman and access-to-information policy.

nodes.officialName: Ministério da Gestão e da Inovação em Serviços Públicos
nodes.summary: Coordinates federal management, the civil service, digital government and central administrative systems.
Coordinates federal planning and budgeting and monitors medium-term priorities.

nodes.officialName: Fundação Escola Nacional de Administração Pública
nodes.summary: Trains public servants and leaders and produces applied knowledge about public management and policy.

source.title: A escola e sua estrutura organizacional

nodes.officialName: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística
nodes.summary: Produces the official statistics, censuses and geographic information used across the country.
Researches public policy and advises the state on strategic decisions.
Runs monetary policy, regulates the financial system and operates core payment infrastructure.

nodes.officialName: Ministério do Desenvolvimento, Indústria, Comércio e Serviços
nodes.summary: Sets federal policy for productive development, trade, industry and services.

nodes.officialName: Banco Nacional de Desenvolvimento Econômico e Social
nodes.summary: Provides long-term finance and structures investment for firms and governments.

nodes.officialName: Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação
nodes.summary: Coordinates federal science, technology and innovation policy.
Finances research, development and innovation in firms, universities and technology institutes.

nodes.officialName: Conselho Nacional de Desenvolvimento Científico e Tecnológico
nodes.summary: Provides grants and scholarships for scientific and technological research.
Coordinates federal education policy and regulates higher education within its remit.

nodes.officialName: Coordenação de Aperfeiçoamento de Pessoal de Nível Superior
nodes.summary: Evaluates graduate education and funds the training of researchers and teachers.
Coordinates federal agriculture, livestock and food-supply policy.
Performs agricultural research and converts scientific knowledge into production systems.
Coordinates the Unified Health System at federal level and sets national health policy.
Produces research, technology, training and services for the public health system.
Regulates products and services subject to health surveillance.

nodes.officialName: Serviço Federal de Processamento de Dados
nodes.summary: Builds and operates digital systems used by the federal administration.

nodes.officialName: Empresa de Tecnologia e Informações da Previdência
nodes.summary: Processes data and runs systems for social-security and social-policy delivery.
Enforces competition law and rules on mergers and anticompetitive conduct.
Grants and administers industrial-property rights such as patents and trademarks.

nodes.officialName: Governo do Estado de São Paulo
nodes.summary: Heads the Sao Paulo state executive and coordinates statewide policy and services.

source.title: Estrutura do Governo de São Paulo

nodes.officialName: Assembleia Legislativa do Estado de São Paulo
nodes.summary: Passes state laws and the state budget and scrutinizes the Sao Paulo executive.

nodes.officialName: Tribunal de Justiça do Estado de São Paulo
nodes.summary: Adjudicates cases in the Sao Paulo state court system.

nodes.officialName: Tribunal de Contas do Estado de São Paulo
nodes.summary: Audits accounts, contracts and spending by the state and municipalities within its jurisdiction.

nodes.officialName: Ministério Público do Estado de São Paulo
nodes.summary: Defends the legal order and social interests in Sao Paulo state.

nodes.officialName: Controladoria Geral do Estado de São Paulo
nodes.summary: Coordinates internal control, integrity and audit in the Sao Paulo executive.

nodes.officialName: Fundação de Amparo à Pesquisa do Estado de São Paulo
nodes.summary: Funds scientific and technological research performed at institutions in Sao Paulo.
State public university that trains people and performs research across many fields.
State public university with a strong research and science-and-technology training role.

nodes.officialName: Universidade Estadual Paulista Júlio de Mesquita Filho
nodes.summary: State public university distributed across multiple cities in Sao Paulo.

nodes.officialName: Instituto de Pesquisas Tecnológicas do Estado de São Paulo
nodes.summary: State institute providing applied research, testing and technology services.

nodes.officialName: Companhia de Processamento de Dados do Estado de São Paulo
nodes.summary: State company that builds and operates digital services for the Sao Paulo government.
State financial agency providing credit to firms and municipal projects.

nodes.officialName: Centro Estadual de Educação Tecnológica Paula Souza
nodes.summary: Runs technical schools and technology colleges across Sao Paulo state.

nodes.officialName: Prefeitura do Município de São Paulo
nodes.summary: Governs the municipality of Sao Paulo and delivers local services directly to residents.
Private university centre in Sao Paulo focused on technology, management and related fields.
